title.narrative: Application for support in monitoring, evaluation & communications

description.narrative: Protimos addresses impoverishment issues that can be resolved by the use of the law in the public interest, in IPRs and Biodiversity, and in Governance. We would now like to develop our capacity to measure and assess the impact of our Public Interest project in Lesotho as a new benchmark. We would like to communicate this impact more widely, sharing information and knowledge with those who need it and enabling us, to gain more funding, for existing and new projects, for the social investor and the philanthropist. Investment in our impact assessment programme and improving our communications will enable us to articulate and disseminate the work more widely. Consequently legal and international development professions and organisations will be able to work more closely and efficiently with indigenous and marginalized communities, CSOs, multi-national corporations, specialist lawyers, anthropologists, economists and financial institutions. In acquiring the skills and the resources which enable us to measure and describe the impact of the work, we can thus build support for legal empowerment, whilst developing a greater depth of analysis and clearer articulation for the social impact investor in African legal empowerment work.
